subject.title: feat: add opt-in --send-spacing to pace delegated sends

question: Should `sync --follow` expose an opt-in delegated-send pacing policy as a supported CLI contract after the deadline bug is repaired?
rationale: The implementation is a new operator-facing behavior and configuration flag rather than a repair to an established command contract; maintainers need to decide whether this scope and naming belong in the core CLI.

options.title: Accept the scoped pacing flag
options.body: Keep the flag limited to follow-daemon delegated sends, after aligning connection and request deadlines and obtaining real behavior proof.

options.title: Defer the policy surface
options.body: Decline or postpone the new flag if pacing should instead remain an automation-layer responsibility or use a different core interface.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped pacing flag
recommendation.body: Keep the flag limited to follow-daemon delegated sends, after aligning connection and request deadlines and obtaining real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Most likely available owner for a core CLI product-direction choice around send behavior.
